purpose: To ensure a company makes an offer or invitation to subscribe to securities through private placement only after the proposal has been previously approved by the shareholders by a special resolution.
who: Not stated in the Rules text
when: Not stated in the Rules text
steps: Obtain previous approval of the shareholders by a special resolution for each of the offers or invitations.
Prepare the explanatory statement annexed to the notice for shareholders approval containing all required disclosures.
checklist: Particulars of the offer including date of passing of Board resolution
Kinds of securities offered and the price at which security is being offered
Basis or justification for the price including premium
Name and address of valuer who performed valuation
Amount which the company intends to raise by way of such securities
Material terms of raising such securities, proposed time schedule, and purposes or objects of offer
watch: Not stated in the Rules text
